description: Focused LLM review repair: keep JSON-RPC batch responses visible through the production weave-mcp stdio-to-HTTP bridge.

userStories.title: Forward JSON-RPC batch responses through weave-mcp bridge
userStories.problem: RunHTTPBridge classifies requests by sniffing an object-level id. A top-level JSON-RPC batch array therefore looks notification-only to the bridge, so mixed batches with request ids are forwarded upstream but their valid batch response is dropped from stdout.
userStories.userStory: As a local MCP client using weave-mcp over stdio, I want batch request results to be forwarded back as one response line so tool discovery and other batched calls do not silently hang or lose results.
bddAcceptance: Given a stdio client sends one JSON-RPC batch line with two requests and one notification, when RunHTTPBridge forwards it to /mcp and receives a batch response, then stdout emits exactly one batch response line containing the two request ids.
Given a stdio client sends a JSON-RPC batch line that contains only notifications, when RunHTTPBridge forwards it to /mcp and receives no response body, then stdout emits no output line.
Given a JSON-RPC batch contains any item that expects a response or is invalid, when RunHTTPBridge classifies the envelope before forwarding, then it does not treat the envelope as notification-only.
Given a single JSON-RPC notification object is forwarded through RunHTTPBridge, when upstream returns no body, then existing no-output notification behavior is preserved.
